_readme: Copy to mapping.json (git-ignored) and replace the fictional 'fjordtek' values with your customer.
replacements: map the customer NAME itself first. It is matched inside longer words, case-insensitive,
so 'fjordtek' also covers fjordtek.no, func-fjordtek-prod, kv-fjordtek, FJORDTEK-PC042.
Add longer phrases only when they need their own placeholder. Longest match wins.
Use "wholeWord": true for short names/abbreviations that could appear inside other words.
Every placeholder must be unique ignoring case ('contoso' and 'Contoso' count as the same).
patterns: reversible custom regex. {n} = running number. A group named 'v' limits what is replaced.
secretPatterns: irreversible custom regex, replaced with <redacted:name>.
ignore: values that are never touched (well-known Microsoft app IDs, localhost).
